### The Hero Who Set His Face
Author: Justin Dillehay
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/hero-set-his-face/
Passage: Luke 9:51
Points:
- Jesus demonstrated unflinching commitment to the Father's mission by walking directly toward Jerusalem and the cross.
- He displayed undaunted courage by leading out ahead rather than retreating into self-preservation.
- Christ acted with unshakable faith, trusting God to vindicate and resurrect Him beyond His suffering.
- His resolve was fueled by sacrificial love for God and for the people He came to redeem.
- Followers of Jesus are called to imitate His steadfastness when facing trials and cross-bearing.

### Losing Direction and Doubling Your Speed - Love Worth Finding - February 2
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-2-2023.html
Passage: Luke 9:52-56
Points:
- Religious zeal becomes destructive when believers run ahead of God rather than walking with Him.
- Offended by Samaritan rejection, James and John wanted permission to call down annihilating judgment.
- Jesus rebuked their vengeful attitude, clarifying that He came to save lives rather than destroy them.
- Fanaticism often occurs when people lose spiritual direction yet accelerate their hostile energy.
- True passion for Christ must always be guided by and display God's grace.
